item.title: Fly tipping by barset sheltered housing, 6th August
item.description:
The fly-tipping outside the sheltered housing needs urgent attention. There is a risk that local children could take items from the rubbish, play with them, or smash them up, which could cause injuries. The dumped waste is also blocking the pathway, making it difficult or impossible for residents who use wheelchairs, mobility scooters, walking frames, or other mobility aids to pass safely. As this is sheltered housing, keeping access routes clear is especially important. Please could this be treated as a priority and arranged for removal as soon as possible to prevent accidents and ensure safe access for all residents.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Barset Road, Nunhead, Greater London
